production.note: US model years 2015-2023. Dodge: "All-new 2015 Dodge Charger R/T Scat Pack model (late availability) features a 6.4-liter HEMI V-8". Sold as the R/T Scat Pack (2016-2018 sheets) and later as the Scat Pack (2023 sheet, source dodge-charger-specs-2023). Charger production at Brampton ended on December 22, 2023 (GM Authority, source gmauthority-challenger-end-2023).

displacementL.note: 6,417 cc. Dodge 2016 specifications: "392 cu. in. (6,417 cu. cm)"; the 2023 sheet repeats it.

drivetrain.note: "rear-wheel drive (RWD), all-wheel drive (AWD)", with AWD on the SXT and GT only.

transmission.note: "8HP70 TORQUEFLITE AUTOMATIC EIGHT-SPEED: Standard on Charger R/T, R/T Road & Track, R/T Scat Pack and SRT 392"; no manual was offered. 2023: TorqueFlite 8HP70 "Standard with 5.7-liter and 392 HEMI V-8 engines" (source dodge-charger-specs-2023).

powerHp.note: Quote (Dodge 2016 specifications, 6.4-liter 392 HEMI, "Standard — R/T Scat Pack and SRT 392"): "Power (estimated SAE net) 485 bhp (362 kW) @ 6,000 rpm". Dodge's Charger sheets for 2016-2018 print 'estimated SAE net' for this engine; the 2023 sheet gives "Power (SAE net) 485 bhp (362 kW) @ 6,100 rpm", "Standard — Scat Pack models" (source dodge-charger-specs-2023), and Dodge's 2015 launch release gives "485 horsepower and 475 lb.-ft. of torque" (source dodge-charger-release-2015), so the rating was 485 hp for the whole run. The 2016-2018 sheets label the rating 'estimated SAE net'; Dodge's 2015 release and 2023 sheet give 485 hp without that label.

weightLb.note: 2016 model (8-speed automatic, the only transmission). Quote (Dodge 2016 specifications, "Curb Weight, lb. (kg)"): "R/T Scat Pack — 4,395 (1987.6)". The printed kg figure is a copy of the SRT 392 line ("SRT 392 — 4,382 (1987.6)"); the lb figure is confirmed by the 2017 sheet, "R/T Scat Pack, Daytona 392 — 4,395 (1994)" (source dodge-charger-specs-2017). No Dodge sheet for 2015 could be opened (403), so the reference year is 2016, the earliest year with a Dodge figure. Later figures: 2018 "R/T Scat Pack, Daytona 392 — 4,389 (1991)" (dodge-charger-specs-2018), 2023 "4,361 (1,978) — Scat Pack" (dodge-charger-specs-2023).

sources.title: New 2015 Dodge Charger: The World's Only Four-door Muscle Car is the Quickest, Fastest and Most Powerful Sedan in the World
Production Of Camaro Rival Dodge Challenger Ends Today, by Jonathan Lopez (December 22, 2023)

discrepancies.reason: Model year: all are Dodge curb weights for the (R/T) Scat Pack: 4,395 lb for 2016 and 2017, 4,389 lb for 2018, 4,361 lb for 2023.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 4,395 lb because the reference model year is 2016, the earliest year with a Dodge figure.
